section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion summarizes a single (unnumbered) study of Chinese BAS-2 administered to university students in Hong Kong, reporting a one-dimensional factor structure that retained all 10 BAS-2 items and good internal consistency. The authors report convergent validity (associations with self-esteem and life satisfaction), sex differences (men higher than women), and significant associations between body appreciation and BMI in women and BMI2 in men; they also present a preliminary cross-cultural comparison suggesting slightly higher body appreciation than North American adults.
